integrity: The exact finite-field verifier supplements a uniform proof. The cited 2024 source already contains the characteristic-three model, ordinarity, and complete-rational-splitting criterion; they are acknowledged as prior.
scientific_limitations: Classification concerns literal nonzero parameters and rational two-torsion of the specific characteristic-three specialization; it does not count isomorphism classes, determine Weil polynomials, or classify all automorphisms.
title: Frobenius splitting trichotomy and rational two-torsion in a characteristic-three dihedral genus-two family
